items.a1: Та утсаар (+82-2-797-2773), KakaoTalk-аар эсвэл онлайн захиалгын маягтаар зөвлөгөө захиалах боломжтой. Хүссэн огноо, цагаа мэдэгдвэл бид цаг товлоно.
items.a2: Эмчилгээний хугацаа янз бүр: Ultherapy Prime 60-90 минут, Thermage 30-60 минут, Ботокс/Филлер 15-30 минут. Зөвлөгөөний үеэр дэлгэрэнгүй мэдээлэл авна.
items.q3: Эмчилгээний дараа өдөр тутмын үйл ажиллагаандаа эргэх боломжтой юу?
items.a3: Ихэнх мэс заслын бус эмчилгээ нь өдөр тутмын үйл ажиллагаандаа тэр өдөртөө эргэх боломжийг олгодог. Эмчилгээний хэсгээс хамаарч түр зуурын хавдар, хөхрөлт гарч болох ч ихэвчлэн 1-2 долоо хоногт арилдаг.
items.a4: Үнэ нь эмчилгээний хэсэг, цар хүрээ, ашигласан бүтээгдэхүүнээс хамаарч өөр өөр байна. Танд тохирсон хувийн зөвлөгөөгөөр үнийг тодорхой мэдэх боломжтой.
items.a5: Тийм, барилгын дотор газар доорх зогсоол байна. Эмчилгээний үйлчлүүлэгчдэд 2 цагийн үнэгүй зогсоол олгоно.
items.a6: Тусгай бэлтгэл шаардлагагүй. Гэхдээ эмчилгээний өдөр хөнгөн будалт эсвэл будалтгүй ирнэ үү. Тодорхой процедурын хувьд эмчилгээний өмнөх тусгай заавар өгч болно.
items.q7: Гадаадын иргэд зөвлөгөө авч болох уу?
items.a7: Тийм, англи, япон, хятад хэлээр зөвлөгөө авах боломжтой. Захиалгын үед орчуулагч хэрэгтэй бол мэдэгдээрэй.
items.q8: Та зөвхөн жинхэнэ тоног төхөөрөмж ашигладаг уу?
items.a8: LIV Гоо Заслын Эмнэлэг бол Ultherapy Prime, Thermage-ийн албан ёсоор баталгаажсан эмнэлэг бөгөөд зөвхөн 100% жинхэнэ тоног төхөөрөмж, бүтээгдэхүүн ашигладаг. Бүх бүтээгдэхүүний үнэн бодит байдлыг батлах гэрчилгээ боломжтой.

extended.q: Can I return to daily activities immediately after Ultherapy Prime?
extended.a: Yes, Ultherapy Prime is a non-invasive treatment with minimal downtime. You may experience slight redness or swelling immediately after, but this typically subsides within the same day. Makeup can be applied immediately, and there are no restrictions on daily activities.

extended.q: Can I combine Ultherapy Prime with Thermage?
extended.a: Yes, Ultherapy Prime and Thermage are complementary treatments that create synergy when combined. Ultherapy Prime targets deep SMAS layer lifting, while Thermage improves epidermis-dermis elasticity. Typically, treatments are spaced 3 months apart.

extended.q: How can I verify authentic Ultherapy Prime?
extended.a: LIV Plastic Surgery is an official Merz Korea certified clinic. You can verify the serial number of genuine transducers during treatment, and we transparently disclose the actual number of shots delivered.

extendedFaqs.q: Which is better, Thermage or Ultherapy Prime?
extendedFaqs.a: The two treatments are complementary. Ultherapy Prime is effective for deep lifting of the SMAS layer, while Thermage excels at overall elasticity improvement through dermal collagen contraction. Ultherapy Prime is recommended for severe sagging, Thermage for elasticity concerns.
FLX minimizes discomfort during treatment with Comfort Pulse Technology. Treatment can be performed without anesthesia, and most patients only feel a tolerable level of heat.

extendedFaqs.q: How can I verify Thermage authenticity?

extendedFaqs.a: Yes, you can experience immediate lifting effects with a single treatment. However, for optimal results, 2-3 treatments at 3-6 month intervals are recommended depending on your skin condition.

extendedFaqs.q: Is there downtime after Density treatment?
extendedFaqs.a: Generally, there is minimal to no downtime. You may experience slight redness or swelling immediately after treatment, but this typically subsides within the same day. You can resume daily activities and apply makeup right away.

extendedFaqs.q: Can I get Density if I've had Ultherapy Prime or Thermage before?
extendedFaqs.a: Yes, it's possible. However, we recommend waiting at least 3 months after your previous treatment. Through consultation, we'll assess your skin condition and determine the optimal timing for your treatment.

items.a: The biggest advantage of laser toning is 'zero downtime.' Mild redness may appear immediately after treatment but subsides within 30 minutes to 1 hour. items.q: What's the difference between Ulblanc and laser toning?

items.q: Is laser hair removal permanent?
items.a: Laser hair removal is classified as "Permanent Hair Reduction." Since it targets hair follicles in the growth phase, you can expect 80-90% permanent reduction after completing treatment. Some dormant follicles may transition to growth phase, causing slight regrowth, so 1-2 maintenance treatments per year are recommended.

items.q: Does laser hair removal hurt?
items.a: Clarity II's built-in cryogen cooling system continuously cools the skin during treatment, minimizing pain. Most clients describe it as a "rubber band snap" level of mild sensation. Numbing cream can be applied beforehand if needed.

items.q: Can light-colored (blonde, white) hair be removed?
items.a: Laser hair removal targets melanin, so it has limited effectiveness on white, blonde, or light-colored hair with low melanin content. Electrolysis may be an alternative in these cases. We'll assess your hair color during consultation and recommend the optimal method.

items.q: Can I get hair removal if I have dark skin?
items.a: Yes, Clarity II's 1064nm Nd:YAG wavelength is safe for use on dark skin (Fitzpatrick Type IV-VI). The 755nm Alexandrite is optimized for lighter skin, while 1064nm is optimized for darker skin, enabling customized treatment for all skin types.

items.q: Are there pre- and post-treatment precautions?
items.a: Before treatment: Avoid waxing, plucking, and depilatory creams for 2 weeks before; shaving only. Avoid excessive tanning on treatment day. After treatment: Avoid saunas and intense exercise for 24-48 hours, and apply sunscreen diligently.

items.q: How many sessions are needed to see results?
items.a: Results vary by area and individual hair characteristics, but optimal results are typically achieved after 6-10 sessions. Since lasers are only effective during the growth phase (Anagen), multiple sessions at 4-8 week intervals are needed to target follicles at different cycle stages.

faq.a: Most tattoos can be removed over 90%. Complete removal depends on ink color, depth, tattoo age, and skin type. Black ink removes best, while green and blue may require more sessions. We'll provide accurate estimates during consultation.

Pain levels range from 'snapping rubber band' to 'pinching' depending on the individual. Lucas pico laser has 1000x shorter pulse than traditional nanosecond lasers, reducing heat buildup and pain. Numbing cream can be applied to minimize discomfort.

Pico laser minimizes heat damage, making scarring risk very low. With proper energy settings and treatment intervals, most recover without scarring. Following post-care guidelines (sun protection, no scab picking) ensures clean healing.

faq.q: Are older or newer tattoos easier to remove?
faq.a: Generally, older tattoos remove easier as the body's immune system naturally removes some ink particles over time. However, new tattoos can also be effectively removed with pico laser, and their clearer ink can make laser targeting easier.

faq.q: Can all ink colors be removed?
faq.a: Most colors can be removed. Lucas pico laser offers multiple wavelengths (532nm, 755nm, 1064nm) to address various colors.

faq.q: Why is the treatment interval 6-8 weeks?
faq.a: Laser-shattered ink particles are absorbed by macrophages and discharged through the lymphatic system. This natural healing process takes 4-6 weeks, and the next treatment should only proceed after complete skin recovery. Too-frequent treatments increase skin damage and scarring risk.

faq.question: What is the difference between Ultherapy Prime and Thermage?
faq.shortAnswer: Ultherapy uses ultrasound for deep layers, Thermage uses RF for elasticity.
faq.answer: Ultherapy Prime uses HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound) technology to deliver energy deep into the skin's SMAS layer. Thermage uses RF (radiofrequency) energy to contract and promote regeneration of collagen in the dermal layer. Ultherapy Prime is effective for lifting sagging skin, while Thermage is effective for overall skin elasticity improvement. Combining both treatments can produce synergistic effects.

faq.question: How painful are lifting treatments?
faq.shortAnswer: Treatment is performed after numbing cream, and most people can tolerate it.
faq.answer: The pain level of lifting treatments varies depending on the treatment type and individual tolerance. Both Ultherapy Prime and Thermage FLX are performed after applying numbing cream for about 30 minutes. Thermage FLX in particular uses vibration technology (Vibrating Tip) that significantly reduces discomfort. Most patients can receive treatment comfortably. If you are sensitive to pain, additional pain control is available - please let us know during consultation.

faq.question: How often should I get lifting treatments?
faq.shortAnswer: Ultherapy is recommended once every 1-2 years, Thermage once every 6 months to 1 year.
faq.answer: Ultherapy Prime is recommended once every 1-2 years, and Thermage once every 6 months to 1 year. Maintenance treatments like Shurink or InMode can be done every 3-6 months. The treatment cycle may vary depending on your skin condition and desired results, so it's best to determine the exact frequency through consultation.

faq.question: How long do lifting results last?
faq.shortAnswer: Ultherapy lasts about 1-2 years, Thermage about 6 months to 1 year.
faq.answer: Ultherapy Prime results last about 1 year, while Thermage lasts 6 months to 1 year. However, the duration may vary depending on individual skin condition, age, and lifestyle. Regular maintenance treatments can help extend the results.

faq.question: Will Botox make my facial expressions look unnatural?
faq.shortAnswer: Proper dosage at correct injection sites maintains natural expressions.
faq.answer: When the proper amount is injected at the correct locations, natural expressions are maintained while only improving wrinkles. Unnatural expressions typically occur from overdosing or incorrect injection sites. At LIV Plastic Surgery, our experienced specialists inject appropriate amounts tailored to each individual's muscle characteristics, so you can expect natural results.

faq.question: How long does Botox last?
faq.shortAnswer: Usually 3-6 months, lasting longer with regular treatments.
faq.answer: Botox results vary by individual but typically last 3-6 months. With regular treatments, muscles gradually weaken, making results last longer and extending the interval between treatments. A touch-up may be needed 2-3 weeks after the first treatment, so it's good to check progress.

faq.question: Can fillers be dissolved?
faq.shortAnswer: Yes, hyaluronic acid fillers can be safely removed with dissolving injections.
faq.answer: Yes, hyaluronic acid fillers can be dissolved with hyaluronidase (dissolving injection). If you're not satisfied with the results or experience side effects, they can be safely removed. This is one of the major advantages of hyaluronic acid fillers. However, non-reversible fillers (e.g., Artecoll) cannot be dissolved, so consider this when choosing fillers.

faq.question: Can fillers cause lumps or unevenness?
faq.shortAnswer: This rarely occurs when experienced doctors use genuine products.
faq.answer: When genuine fillers are used in appropriate amounts by experienced medical professionals with anatomical knowledge, these problems rarely occur. Occasional unevenness can usually be resolved with massage, and if necessary, can be adjusted with hyaluronidase. If you experience any discomfort after treatment, please consult us immediately.

faq.question: How many sessions of skin boosters are needed for results?
faq.shortAnswer: A basic course of 3-4 sessions is recommended, with maintenance every 2-3 months.
faq.answer: Skin boosters are recommended as a basic course of 3-4 sessions at 2-4 week intervals. You may notice hydration improvement after one session, but the optimal effect requires completing the full course. Afterward, maintenance treatments every 2-3 months are recommended.

faq.question: Should I avoid sunlight after laser treatment?
faq.shortAnswer: Yes, SPF 50+ sunscreen is essential for at least 2-4 weeks.
faq.answer: Yes, sun protection is very important after laser treatment. After treatment, your skin becomes sensitive and the risk of pigmentation from UV exposure increases. For at least 2-4 weeks, apply sunscreen (SPF 50+) thoroughly and use hats or parasols. It's best to avoid laser treatment during seasons with a lot of outdoor activities.

faq.question: What is the downtime after laser treatment?
faq.shortAnswer: Toning has no downtime, pigment lasers take about 3-5 days.
faq.answer: It depends on the type of laser. Laser toning has almost no downtime, allowing immediate return to daily activities. When treating surface pigmentation with Clarity II laser, the pigment may darken or thin scabs may form for 3-5 days before naturally falling off.

faq.question: How long do thread lift results last?
faq.shortAnswer: PDO threads last 6-8 months, PCL threads last 12-18 months.
faq.answer: It depends on the type of thread. PDO (dissolvable threads) last 6-8 months, while PLLA or PCL threads last 12-18 months. As threads dissolve, they promote collagen regeneration, so effects continue for some time even after threads are completely absorbed. Regular maintenance treatments can extend the results.

faq.question: Can I just have a consultation? Is there a fee?
faq.shortAnswer: Yes, consultation fee is 10,000 KRW, fully deducted if treatment is done same day.

faq.question: Can I receive treatment while pregnant or breastfeeding?
faq.shortAnswer: No, most cosmetic treatments are not recommended during pregnancy/breastfeeding.
faq.answer: Most cosmetic treatments are not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. The safety of Botox, fillers, and lifting treatments on the fetus or breast milk has not been sufficiently verified. We recommend receiving treatment after pregnancy and breastfeeding are complete.
